name: jianying-edit
description: Native, fully editable JianYing drafts via the vendored Apache-2.0 pyJianYingDraft engine plus the built-in Rust jycut CLI: multi-track video/text/audio, the 453-name transition catalog, keyframes, masks, styled text and SRT captions; optional fork pro-tier for native export and existing-draft editing. No account, no upload.

description_i18n.en: Native, fully editable JianYing drafts via the vendored Apache-2.0 pyJianYingDraft engine plus the built-in Rust jycut CLI: multi-track video/text/audio, the 453-name transition catalog, keyframes, masks, styled text and SRT captions; optional fork pro-tier for native export and existing-draft editing. No account, no upload.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过插件内置的 Apache-2.0 pyJianYingDraft 引擎与 Rust jycut CLI 生成剪映原生草稿：多轨视频/文字/音频、453 转场目录、关键帧、蒙版、样式文本与 SRT 字幕；fork 专业档提供原生导出与已有草稿编辑。
